mintAuthority.summary: HOLLAR has five native facilitators, not one exclusive Aave-v3 borrowing path. Pinned token runtime and all four previously unresolved facilitator addresses establish externally raiseable ceilings: the local facilitators lack token management roles, while separate runtime governance retains cap-changing and upgrade powers. HSM and FlashMinter executable correspondence and GIGAHDX/BIL implementation identities are bound to official source artifacts. Whole backing allocation, complete governance execution reach and collateral-gated issuance remain uncertified.

controls.label: Hydration Aave-v3 fork money market (minter)
controls.capDescription: The Hydration Market facilitator 0x8c0f3b9602374198974d2b2679d14a386f5b108e has a 13,000,000 HOLLAR bucket capacity at Hydration block 15249643. The launch borrowing cap was 2,000,000 HOLLAR; the current token also lists HOLLAR Stability Module, HOLLAR FlashMinter, GIGAHDX and BIL facilitators, each with its own capacity.
controls.evidence: Pinned Hydration block 15249643 on 2026-10-01: getFacilitator labels this address Hydration Market; getFacilitatorBucket returns capacity 13000000e18. GhoToken.mint enforces each facilitator's bucketCapacity, while BUCKET_MANAGER_ROLE can change capacities. getFacilitatorsList returns five facilitators, so the money market is not the sole mint path. hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xaa7e0000000000000000000000000000000aa7e0) returns true.

controls.label: Hydration governance / parameter admin
controls.capDescription: Hydration governance sets collateral onboarding, risk parameters, supply caps, and the HSM configuration; HOLLAR is governed by Hydration rather than Polkadot OpenGov directly.
controls.evidence: Coverage notes HOLLAR is governed by Hydration (not DOT holders), which controls collateral rules, risk parameters, and the on-chain HOLLAR Stability Module. Hydration's pinned runtime source configures HSM AuthorityOrigin as Root, EconomicParameters, or GeneralAdmin.

controls.label: Hydration OpenGov root track runtime upgrade origin
controls.evidence: Hydration's runtime composes System, ConvictionVoting, Referenda, Origins, Whitelist, and Dispatcher, and its pinned governance configuration defines a `root` referendum track. Runtime code changes are Root-origin operations, so the root OpenGov track is the on-chain governance route that can replace the runtime minting logic. At Hydration block 13133392, state_getRuntimeVersion reported hydradx specVersion 428.

controls.label: HOLLAR Stability Module facilitator
controls.capDescription: At Hydration block 15404466, the HSM bucket capacity is 18,000,000 HOLLAR. The bytecode-bound runtime pallet can mint, burn, flash-borrow and query capacity, but has no capacity-setting call. The separate token BUCKET_MANAGER_ROLE and runtime governance can raise the ceiling; this is not a fixed economic cap.

sources.label: Official hydradx/447 release and deployed runtime code hash

controls.evidence: 2026-10-05 research, Hydration EVM block 15404466 (0x6bb2b046cba1f4a6d4b5f21c4fa35020acf062f3e68e4d2f117a88d8fd04fc28): the runtime :code Blake2b-256 remains 0x0b1bc5812823c7f307f7042b2efdea695dfe95f64197599315f3c4f423dc3123, matching official v53 hydradx/447. HsmPalletId py/hsmod maps to this address. Complete HSM source invokes only token mint, burn, flashLoan, maxFlashLoan and getFacilitatorBucket selectors; it cannot set its own bucket capacity or grant token roles. HOLLAR deployed runtime matches the official GhoToken artifact after exactly the constructor decimals=18, chainId=222222 and recomputed EIP-712 domain immutables. At the same pin, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, FACILITATOR_MANAGER_ROLE and BUCKET_MANAGER_ROLE are held by runtime address 0xaa7e0000000000000000000000000000000aa7e0, not this HSM account. Capacity 18000000e18 and level 540630164470200441773972 are observed, not a fixed global ceiling. Root/EconomicParameters/GeneralAdmin can alter pallet configuration and separate governance can replace runtime; no noninterference, immutable allocation or collateral-gated verdict is claimed.

controls.label: HOLLAR FlashMinter facilitator
controls.capDescription: At Hydration block 15404466, the bucket has capacity 100,000 HOLLAR and level zero. Exact instantiated GhoFlashMinter runtime has no capacity-setting, role-granting, upgrade, delegatecall or arbitrary target-call entrypoint; the separate token bucket manager can raise this ceiling.

sources.label: Official FlashMinter deployed runtime and literal-source artifact

controls.evidence: 2026-10-05 research at Hydration block 15404466/hash 0x6bb2b046cba1f4a6d4b5f21c4fa35020acf062f3e68e4d2f117a88d8fd04fc28: published GhoFlashMinter deployedBytecode matches every runtime byte after substituting only its constructor immutable GHO_TOKEN=0x531a654d1696ed52e7275a8cede955e82620f99a, ADDRESSES_PROVIDER=0xf3ba4d1b50f78301bdd7eaea9b67822a15fca691 and ACL_MANAGER=0x8c5e657ca8879ada34555130f3be255ae47558b5; public getters and provider.getACLManager independently agree. Its mint path flashLoan mints to the receiver, requires the callback magic value, transfers principal plus fee back, then burns principal in the same transaction. Other entrypoints only expose quotes, distribute fees or update fee/treasury through ACL pool-admin authorization; none sets token capacity, grants token roles or replaces executable targets. Token hasRole reads deny all three management roles to this facilitator and grant them to the separate runtime admin. Thus canRaiseCap=false describes this immutable local contract, not the externally raiseable token ceiling. Fee=100 bps and current bucket level=0 are observations, not absence of latent mint authority.

Its complete runtime matches the official GhoAToken artifact after constructor immutables chainId=222222, POOL=0x2ce2cfff743cdb6637f4b5d351937a541b8c8923 and addressesProvider=0x3c7d7b74bb625736b93d859e332f06df64635973, independently matched by POOL() and pool.ADDRESSES_PROVIDER(). UNDERLYING_ASSET_ADDRESS() is HOLLAR. Source transferUnderlyingTo mints via the token and onlyPool; it has no bucket setter or role-grant entrypoint. More decisively, bytecode-bound HOLLAR AccessControl denies DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, BUCKET_MANAGER_ROLE and FACILITATOR_MANAGER_ROLE to this facilitator, while all three are held by separate runtime admin 0xaa7e0000000000000000000000000000000aa7e0. Local proxy code replacement cannot itself bypass those token checks; future token role grants/cap increases remain separate administration risks. The provider owner is that runtime admin. Thus local canRaiseCap=false does not establish a fixed ceiling, immutable proxy, governed-only issuance, collateral closure or execution-scope completeness.

review.evidence: Hydration press and coverage describe HOLLAR as an Aave-v3/GHO-derived overcollateralized stablecoin with the native HSM for peg support, governed by Hydration with parameter-level control over collateral and caps. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: collateral-gated issuance is capped but Hydration OpenGov can raise caps and upgrade runtime logic; no off-chain reserve claim or prudential supervisor applies. D14/A7 review on 2026-10-03 at hydration EVM block 15353261 (0x28fe556392f72a8673f16b503369d3a5a4e4b70e401e63cbb093a426a72e4ce4, re-fetched with eth_getBlockByNumber): pinned token code and getFacilitatorsList still identify five native facilitators, and hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xaa7e0000000000000000000000000000000aa7e0) is true. The official pinned GhoToken source permits arbitrary facilitator admission and capacity changes without a collateral predicate, but this run cannot certify its bytecode correspondence or the current runtime origin controlling that admin address. The HSM, GIGAHDX and BIL facilitator collateral/controller closures remain unresolved. An upstream source file, a zero-code runtime address, or a runtime-upgrade power does not prove the complete current D14 root path. A11 sets economicCapSemantics to unknown with no capSemanticsReview. Four cap-limited facilitator controls retain canRaiseCap unknown; the compiler therefore derives unknown despite the same-chain parameter raiser. Curated authorityPosture is unknown, fail-closed. No D29 certificate is authored. This D14 refresh does not re-date older quorum or reserve-reconciliation observations.

review.sourceFreeRationale: Aave-v3/GHO fork mint design is documented by Hydration. Pinned Hydration block 15249643 on 2026-10-01 confirms DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE at 0xaa7e0000000000000000000000000000000aa7e0 and five facilitator entries: Hydration Market, HOLLAR FlashMinter, HOLLAR Stability Module, GIGAHDX and BIL. The previously recorded admin address omitted its final zero. The historical pinned runtime source records HSM AuthorityOrigin as Root, EconomicParameters or GeneralAdmin and a root referendum track. Current state_getRuntimeVersion returns hydradx specVersion 447; this version observation does not independently bind the historical source commit to current runtime code.
